description: List the guided camera tours of a scene and which one plays by default. Use it before editing tours, or to give the user a tour link; every scene gets an automatic default tour after it builds. To create a tour use set_camera_path, to regenerate the automatic one use reset_auto_camera_path, and to remove one use delete_camera_path. Parameter: `scene` is the scene id, job id or a link the user pasted; the returned path ids are what set_camera_path, delete_camera_path and tour links use. Read-only. Works without sign-in for public and unlisted scenes; private scenes need the owner signed in.

scene.description: Scene id (e.g. palm-villa-0a1b2c3d4e5f), the job id returned by upload_scene, or a Verse share link.

name: list_camera_paths

default.description: Id of the tour links play by default.

paths.description: Tours with id, name, mode, key count, chapter labels and auto flag.

tourLink.description: Link that opens the scene playing the default tour.

title: List a scene's camera paths
